definitions.explanation: A set of steps leading from one floor or level to another.

notes:
{階段|かいだん} refers to stairs or a staircase.

WORD STRUCTURE:
{階|かい} (floor/story) + {段|だん} (step/tier)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {階段|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to go up stairs
- {階段|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to go down stairs
- {階段|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧: to run up stairs
- {階段|かいだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall down stairs

- らせん{階段|かいだん}: spiral staircase
- {階段|かいだん}{室|しつ}: stairwell
